summary_en: Board authorized acquisition of up to 189,000 shares (0.32% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥300 million through on-exchange market purchases from October 5-19, 2026, to support flexible capital allocation and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Own Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 1, 2026, the board of directors of Nishimatsuya Chain Co., Ltd. authorized the acquisition of up to 189,000 shares of the company's common stock through on-exchange market purchases. The acquisition window runs from October 5 through October 19, 2026, with a maximum expenditure of ¥300 million and an upper limit of 0.32% of issued shares excluding treasury stock.

The company stated that the buyback is intended to support flexible capital allocation in response to changes in the operating environment and to provide shareholder returns. The acquisition will proceed through purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the specified period.
